description: Check a badgeIA Signed Agent Record (one run's Ed25519-signed result: score inputs, execution mode, benchmark-pack facts) or the attestation an A2A Agent Card / MCP manifest carries. Answers VERIFIED, INVALID or UNSIGNED, and shows the benchmark-pack facts only when the signature verifies. Give exactly one of `record` or `card_url`. Verification trusts only badgeIA's published key set, fetched from its fixed address; no input can change which keys are trusted, and a key or URL named inside a record is never used. Requests this tool can make: badgeIA's key file; for `card_url`, that https URL and the `record_url` the card links to (loopback, private and link-local hosts are refused). Pass `policy` (even {}) to also apply a gate: signature first, then require_success, allowed_execution_modes, max_age_days, min_score (with `score`), require_blueprint_version. No API key required.

card_url.description: https URL of an A2A Agent Card or MCP server manifest carrying a badgeia attestation.

policy.description: Gate policy. Defaults: success required, simulated runs refused, Blueprint version required.

record.description: The Signed Agent Record, as a JSON object.

score.description: The agent's composite_score (already 0-100) for a min_score policy.

name: verify_record
title: Verify a badgeIA Signed Agent Record
